newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: WOMAN ARRESTED FOR SMUGGLING CRABS INTO S.AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: WOMAN ARRESTED FOR SMUGGLING CRABS INTO S.AFRICA.

text.p: An enterprising trader who hitchhiked from Mozambique to South Africa with 500 live crabs for a top Johannesburg seafood restaurant was arrested late on Thursday, preventing a nasty outbreak of food-poisoning.

"Considering how fast dead shellfish goes off and the unhygienic state of the three carrier bags being used to transport the 500 crabs, I shudder to think that they could have been served to unsuspecting diners," said Mpumalanga Parks Board officer Juan de Beer.

The trader was charged with bringing live aquatic fauna into the country without a permit -- a practice police suspect is common between South Africa and Mozambique which has cheap and plentiful seafood of good quality.
